name: GZWinDrawFrame(context, rect, argb, thickness) (cdecl; PushState, SetColor, top / left / right / bottom strips by FillRect, PopState)
notes: Lane UA (drawfx proof). Difftest GZWinHelpers_DrawFrame: 3000 seeds (rects anywhere in -100..700, some inverted or empty, thickness -3..40, any argb) drawn into a recording cIGZDrawContext fake (tests/drawfx.h); the logs (slot, colour, rect contents) compared call by call. The original reads the rect between its draw calls, ours once up front: the same for any draw context that doesn't write to the caller's rect (cGZDrawContext::FillRect 0x8bbbb0 only reads it). Mutants (build/ua_mutants.json): a coordinate +1, colour alpha forced, left/right strips swapped (draw order), PopState dropped: all killed. Hook entry added, not yet run in-game.

name: GZWinDrawBevel(context, rect, argb, raised) (cdecl; fill, then light and dark one-pixel edges shaded by +-0x38 through 0x92f310)
notes: Lane UA (drawfx proof). Hook entry added, not yet run in-game.

name: GZWinShadeColor(red, green, blue, delta) (cdecl; 0xff000000 | each low byte + delta clamped to 0..255)
notes: Lane UA. Difftest GZWinHelpers_ShadeColor: 20000 cases, channels with junk high bytes, 0 / 0xff edges, deltas 0, +-1, +-0x38, +-255, +-256, INT32_MAX, INT32_MIN and random. The original writes the clamped green into its own (cdecl) argument slot: invisible to callers. Mutants: clamp low to 1, channel without its low-byte mask: killed. Hook entry added, not yet run in-game.

name: GZWinHideQuiet(window) (cdecl; null-safe; flag 0x20 cleared around Hide (slot 85), then restored)
notes: Lane UA (winfx proof). Difftest GZWinHelpers_HideQuiet: 600 seeds over random winfx window trees (tests/winfx.h), every tenth with a null window; the call logs and the windows' state afterwards (ids, areas, flags, references, child order) compared. The original restores the flag with the window pointer's high bytes and the flag in the low byte (it stores al into its argument slot); SetFlag reads only the low byte (cGZWin 0x932c88 and 0x9335b5: cmp byte), so the log compares the low byte (kind b). Mutants: restore with 1, null check removed (crash): killed. Hook entry added, not yet run in-game.
